title: Focused controls and discoverable workflows
summary: The terminal release brings a smaller command tray, searchable advanced actions and grouped Settings.
changes: Sixteen essential controls, with advanced actions available through search.
Discover bug replays, fix comparisons, team contracts and app checks from normal requests.
Coordinate with a named live teammate and rename conversations from Settings or Ctrl+R.
Release notes include local deterministic acceptance results and the limits of the local-model smoke test. The npm launcher tarball is attached; registry publication is pending.
